structure.title: SRI SANKARA GLOBAL ACADEMY THURAIPAKKAM
structure.summary: This document is a notice from Sri Sankara Global Academy to parents, thanking them for their support during the academic year 2025-2026. It informs them that the fee structure for the academic year 2026-2027 has been finalized, and requests them to review the attached details and adhere to the payment schedule. The school looks forward to continued partnership with parents in the upcoming year.
